readerCopy.body: A decision you have been postponing may become much more concrete once it comes with a deadline, responsibility, or consequence. When Saturn conjuncts the North Node, the part of the plan that was easy to postpone may suddenly come with paperwork, a date, a title, or people depending on your answer. Signing the contract, accepting the role, committing to the schedule, or closing something that has become too expensive to maintain makes the choice harder to keep theoretical. Pressure is not proof that the answer is yes. It gives you terms you can measure. Read them carefully, then decide what you are willing to carry.
